{{Weapon Infobox |title = Ame­noma Kage­uchi |id = 11414 |image = Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi.png|Base Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi 2nd.png|2nd Ascension |series = Amethyst |type = Sword |releaseDate = 2021-07-21 |quality = 4 |base_atk = 41 |2nd_stat_type = ATK |2nd_stat = 12% |obtain = Forging |diagram = [[The Farmer's Treasure]] Quest |passive = Iwakura Succession |effect = After casting an Elemental Skill, gain 1 Succession Seed. This effect can be triggered once every 5s. The Succession Seed lasts for 30s. Up to 3 Succession Seeds may exist simultaneously. After using an Elemental Burst, all Succession Seeds are consumed and after 2s, the character regenerates (var1) Energy for each seed consumed. |eff_rank1_var1 = 6 |eff_rank2_var1 = 7.5 |eff_rank3_var1 = 9 |eff_rank4_var1 = 10.5 |eff_rank5_var1 = 12 |eff_att1 = Energy Generation }} {{Description|A blade custom made for a famed samurai who could strike down a tengu warrior, known for their incredible agility, in midair.}} {{Lang|'''Amenoma Kageuchi'''|ja=天目影打}} is a [[forge]]able 4-Star [[sword]]. It is part of the [[Amethyst Series]]. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Weapon Ascensions and Stats |ascendMat1 = Coral Branch of a Distant Sea |ascendMat2 = Jeweled Branch of a Distant Sea |ascendMat3 = Jade Branch of a Distant Sea |ascendMat4 = Golden Branch of a Distant Sea |bossMat1 = Chaos Gear |bossMat2 = Chaos Axis |bossMat3 = Chaos Oculus |commonMat1 = Old Handguard |commonMat2 = Kageuchi Handguard |commonMat3 = Famed Handguard }} ==Recipe== {{Recipe |type = Forging |Northlander Sword Billet = 1 |Amethyst Lump = 50 |White Iron Chunk = 50 |Mora = 500 |time = 10s |sort = Northlander Sword Billet;Amethyst Lump;White Iron Chunk;Mora }} ==Gameplay Notes== * Succession Seeds are visualized as small purple orbs floating above the hilt of the sword. * The duration of the Succession Seeds is shared, and obtaining a new succession seed restarts the 30s timer. * The Succession Seeds do not disappear on changing characters, so it is not needed to keep the character on field all the time to obtain the maximum effect from this passive. * You '''do not''' have to hit an enemy with the Elemental Skill to gain Succession Seeds. ==Description== One of the "kageuchi" copies of the famed sword "[[Hakuen Michimitsu Amenoma]]."
It was gifted to the [[Saimon Clan]] by [[Douin]], the founding patriarch of the [[Iwakura Clan]].
This gift was given in thanks for the care that he received from them when he was living in seclusion in [[Konda Village]]. It is said that Iwakura's secret blade technique, Tengu Sweeper, can only be performed when there is not a single trace of confusion in one's heart.
In the past, the name "Tengu Sweeper" sounded the same as "Tengu Victor," and it was a sword strike that could cut a [[Tengu]] soaring in the sky down.
For centuries, the swordsmen of Iwakura, they who inherited the name "In," would use this secret blade to destroy countless evils throughout the Inazuman archipelago. Legend has it that the Tengu Sweeper was first created in the courtyard of a small shrine where incense no longer burned.
The technique was so powerful that it destroyed the building, and Iwakura Douin's sword was broken in two.
After that, he founded the Iwakura Art with his swordsmanship skills and became the instructor of the [[Kujou Clan]].
He would also have the [[Amenoma Smithy|Amenoma]] master of that time craft the sword that would be passed down through the "In" line — the "Hakuen Michimitsu Amenoma." Legends abound concerning the deeds done using that blade. It is said that its edge was so sharp that it might even cut through mortal fate.
As for the overly lengthy name, it is said that Iwakura Douin specified to Amenoma that it be called as such. ==Gallery== Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi 3D.png|Full Weapon - Base Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi 3D 2nd.png|Full Weapon - 2nd Ascension Weapon Card Amenoma Kageuchi.jpg|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/568805 Weapon Details Announcement] Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi Full Icon.png|Full Icon Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi Succession Seed 1.png|Passive: Iwakura Succession - 1 Succession Seed Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi Succession Seed 2.png|Passive: Iwakura Succession - 2 Succession Seeds Weapon Amenoma Kageuchi Succession Seed 3.png|Passive: Iwakura Succession - 3 Succession Seeds ==Availability== * [[Forging]] ** Its [[Diagram]], the [[Saimon Heirloom Blade Diagram]], is obtained from completing [[The Farmer's Treasure]]. ==Trivia== * [[Kamisato Ayaka]] wields the unascended version of this sword in her [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5RCsr1Y8UZA Character Demo], her [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hUDhKYxGh0M Collected Miscellany], the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAlymhPyKhQ Tsubaki in Thawing Snow trailer], and some [[:File:The Heron's Court 2022-04-19 - Kamisato Ayaka Shorts.png|artwork]]. * [[Kuki Shinobu]] is seen wielding the ascended version in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VbFZvVeY0LY Version 2.7 trailer], her [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=13fviLTc0Aw Character Demo], and her [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2sie0jcXi7k Collected Miscellany]. ** She is seen with the unascended version in [[:File:Version 2.7 Wallpaper 1.png|Version 2.7 artwork]]. * [[Kirara]] is seen using the unascended version in her [https://youtu.be/hkUFz8n4rUU Character Demo] and [https://youtu.be/2kgZ7ZGG5-Q Collected Miscellany]. * In Japanese swordsmithing, a sword is called by the name of its swordsmith. The term ''Amenoma'' therefore refers to both the swordsmith [[Amenoma Smithy|Amenoma]] and this sword itself. * The English and Chinese texts of the lore say that the [[Iwakura Clan|Iwakura]]'s sword art Tengu Sweeper sounded the same as the Tengu Victor in the past. In the Japanese version, however, they still sound exactly the same: {{ja|天狗抄|tl=Tengu Raid}} and {{ja|天狗勝|tl=Tengu Victor}} are both pronounced "''Tengu-Shou''." As a result, the Japanese text revises the sentence slightly to say that "Tengu Raid ({{ja|天狗抄}}) is a pun on Tengu Victor ({{ja|天狗勝}})." ===Etymology=== {{See Also|Amenoma Smithy#Etymology|Iwakura Michihiro#Etymology}} * In Japanese swordsmithing, {{Lang|''kageuchi''|ja=影打|ja_tl=shadow forging}} refers to a type of a spare product.Google Books: [https://books.google.co.jp/books?id=kFTNe-WjyBcC&pg=PA122#v=onepage Legends and Stories around the Japanese Sword](pg. 122) In some cases, a swordsmith forges two swords for one order to pursue perfection. After giving the finishing touches, the smith signs their name on the one which they think is better and delivers the work to the customer. The inferior one, or the ''kageuchi'', is left unsigned and usually kept by the swordsmith themself. * The name of the original of this sword, {{Lang|Hakuen Michimitsu|ja=薄縁満光}}, can mean "Ephemeral Fate, Full Light." The legend that it may even slash "mortal fate" ({{ja|人の縁}}) likely refers to the Buddhist philosophy that disregarding and breaking bonds with the Twelve Fates or "{{w|Pratītyasamutpāda|Links}}" ({{ja|縁起}}), which are considered to be the twelve major laws of the world's system (and thus the origins of suffering), is said to lead the person to full enlightenment. ** The name shares the theme with [[Ei]]'s signature sword art [[Musou no Hitotachi]], meaning the Slash of No Conception (Non-Thought). Such analogies between swordsmanship and Buddhism have also been historically common and were mainly developed by the swordsman-philosophers {{w|Yagyū Munenori|Yagyuu Munenori}} and {{w|Miyamoto Musashi}}. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_zhs = 天目影打刀 |1_zhs_rm = Tiānmù Yǐngdǎ-dāo |1_zht = 天目影打刀 |1_zht_rm = Tiānmù Yǐngdǎ-dāo |1_zh_tl = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_ja = 天目影打 |1_ja_rm = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_ja_tl = Amenoma Shadow Forge |1_ko = 아메노마 카게우치가타나 |1_ko_rm = Amenoma Kageuchi-gatana |1_ko_tl = Amenoma Kageuchi Katana |1_es = Espada Amenoma Gemela |1_es_tl = Amenoma Sword Twin |1_es_note = "Twin" refers to ''kageuchi''. See [[#Trivia|Trivia]] for details. |1_fr = Lame kageuchi d'Amenoma |1_fr_tl = Kageuchi Blade of Amenoma |1_ru = Амэнома Кагэути |1_ru_tl = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_th = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_vi = Đoản Đao Amenoma |1_vi_tl = Amenoma Dagger |1_de = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_id = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_pt = Lâmina Amenoma Kageuta |1_pt_tl = Amenoma Shadow-Song Blade |1_pt_note = {{pt|Kageuta}} is a Japanese term for "song sung behind the scenes," so "Shadow-Song" is used here. |1_tr = Amenoma Kageuchi |1_it = Spada delle ombre |1_it_tl = Sword of the Shadows |2_en = Iwakura Succession |2_zhs = 岩藏之胤 |2_zhs_rm = Yáncáng zhī Yìn |2_zht = 岩藏之胤 |2_zht_rm = Yáncáng zhī Yìn |2_zh_tl = Descendant of Iwakura |2_ja = 岩蔵の胤 |2_ja_rm = Iwakura no Tane |2_ja_tl = Descendant of Iwakura |2_ko = 이와쿠라의 후손 |2_ko_rm = Iwakura-ui Huson |2_ko_tl = Descendant of Iwakura |2_es = Legado Iwakura |2_es_tl = Iwakura Legacy |2_fr = Héritage d'Iwakura |2_fr_tl = Iwakura Legacy |2_ru = Наследие Ивакуры |2_ru_tl = Iwakura Legacy |2_th = Iwakura Succession |2_vi = Sự Kế Thừa Iwakura |2_vi_tl = |2_de = Iwakura-Nachkomme |2_de_tl = Iwakura Descendant |2_id = Iwakura Succession |2_pt = Herdeiro de Iwakura |2_pt_tl = |2_tr = Iwakura Halefiyeti |2_tr_tl = Iwakura Succession |2_it = Discendenza d'Iwakura |2_it_tl = Iwakura Lineage }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}} ==References== {{Reflist|1}} ==Navigation== {{Weapons by Series Navbox|series=Amethyst}} {{Weapon Navbox|Swords}} [[es:Espada Amenoma Gemela]] [[fr:Lame kageuchi d'Amenoma]] [[id:Amenoma Kageuchi]] [[it:Spada delle ombre]] [[ja:天目影打]] [[pt-br:Lâmina Amenoma Kageuta]] [[ru:Амэнома Кагэути]] [[th:Amenoma Kageuchi]] [[tr:Amenoma Kageuchi]] [[uk:Аменома Каґеучі]] [[vi:Đoản Đao Amenoma]] [[zh:天目影打刀]]
